omaggio-battiato-villa-pignatelli-2026.title: A tribute to Franco Battiato at Villa Pignatelli
omaggio-battiato-villa-pignatelli-2026.blurb: Quartetto d'Arti, with voice, violin, cello and guitars, plays the songs of the much-loved Italian songwriter Franco Battiato in the concert Perché sei un essere speciale. It's on a Sunday morning, so afterwards you can wander down for a stroll in the Villa Comunale park.

barocco-italiano-florio-porta-del-parco-.title: Antonio Florio and the Italian Baroque at the Auditorium Porta del Parco
barocco-italiano-florio-porta-del-parco-.blurb: Antonio Florio conducts the Ensemble ScarlattiLab in concertos by Scarlatti, Vivaldi, Valentini and Corelli, with Giacomo Lapegna on bassoon. A Saturday afternoon in Bagnoli, part of the Musica Urbana series.

accademia-scala-scarlatti-conservatorio-.title: The Accademia della Scala orchestra opens the Scarlatti season at the Conservatory
accademia-scala-scarlatti-conservatorio-.blurb: The young players of the Teatro alla Scala Academy, with conductor Marco Angius and pianist Ruben Micieli, play Mozart, Beethoven's Second Piano Concerto and Stravinsky's Dumbarton Oaks. Tickets are €20, or €12 if you're under 30.

raiz-love-songs-conservatorio-2026.title: Raiz and IDR, Love Songs at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
raiz-love-songs-conservatorio-2026.blurb: The voice of Almamegretta teams up with the New York ensemble of Marco Cappelli and Jim Pugliese for Neapolitan love songs, from the old repertoire to today, in a world premiere. Part of the Associazione Scarlatti season, €20.

mozart-haydn-porta-del-parco-2026.title: Mozart and Papa Haydn at the Auditorium Porta del Parco
mozart-haydn-porta-del-parco-2026.blurb: The string quartet Musica Nova à Quattro plays Haydn and Mozart's Quartet in D minor. A Saturday afternoon concert, the last October date of the Musica Urbana series.

solisti-aquilani-sciortino-conservatorio.title: I Solisti Aquilani and Orazio Sciortino at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
solisti-aquilani-sciortino-conservatorio.blurb: Orazio Sciortino plays and conducts Mozart's Piano Concerto K 449, then the orchestra takes on Schoenberg's Verklärte Nacht (Transfigured Night). Single tickets are €20 at the box office before the concert.

trio-hermes-barbieri-chiesa-anglicana-20.title: Trio Hermes and Guido Barbieri on Goya and Beethoven at the Anglican Church
trio-hermes-barbieri-chiesa-anglicana-20.blurb: Violin, cello and piano, with Guido Barbieri telling the parallel lives of Goya and Beethoven. The church on via San Pasquale has warm, intimate acoustics, €20.

kainrath-zilberstein-conservatorio-2026.title: Julian Kainrath and Lilya Zilberstein at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
kainrath-zilberstein-conservatorio-2026.blurb: The young violinist Julian Kainrath and pianist Lilya Zilberstein play sonatas by Grieg, Brahms and Prokofiev, with pieces from Romeo and Juliet. Part of the Associazione Scarlatti season, €20.

avion-travel-nos-cortile-statue-2026.title: Avion Travel and the Nuova Orchestra Scarlatti in the Cortile delle Statue
avion-travel-nos-cortile-statue-2026.blurb: The Italian band Avion Travel with the orchestra conducted by Angelo Valori, moving between Paisiello, Piazzolla and their own songs in symphonic dress. It's the last night of the UniMusic festival, with €10 tickets online or at the box office an hour before.
avion-travel-nos-cortile-statue-2026.place: Cortile delle Statue (Courtyard of the Statues), Università Federico II

classical-world-music-piscinola-2026.title: Classical World Music inside Piscinola-Scampia metro station
classical-world-music-piscinola-2026.blurb: The Nuova Orchestra Scarlatti, conducted by Gaetano Russo, and singer Rossella Costa play everything from Rossini to pop inside the Line 1 metro station. Free entry, part of the Fiori musicali per le periferie series that takes music to the city's outskirts.

filarmonica-calabria-cilea-conservatorio.title: The Orchestra Filarmonica della Calabria plays Cilea at the Conservatory
filarmonica-calabria-cilea-conservatorio.blurb: Filippo Arlia conducts the Calabrian orchestra, with Sergio Messina on violin and Francesco Mariozzi on cello, in an all-Francesco Cilea programme. Free entry, in the most beautiful hall of the Conservatory.
filarmonica-calabria-cilea-conservatorio.place: Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, Sala Scarlatti

balance-trio-conservatorio-2026.title: Balance Trio, Piazzolla and friends at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
balance-trio-conservatorio-2026.blurb: Saxophone, cello and piano for music by Elizondo, Glinka and Piazzolla. A free 6pm concert, nicely timed before an aperitivo in piazza Bellini.
balance-trio-conservatorio-2026.place: Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, Sala Scarlatti

organo-in-scena-conservatorio-2026.title: L'organo in scena, Monday organ concerts at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
organo-in-scena-conservatorio-2026.blurb: Six Mondays with different organists for the Conservatory's bicentenary, from Napoli è porosa on 5 October until mid-December. Free entry; the October and November dates are 5, 12 and 26 October and 9 and 23 November.
organo-in-scena-conservatorio-2026.place: Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, Sala Scarlatti

parthenope-market-santissima-settembre-2.title: Parthenope Market at La Santissima, vintage and makers in the Quartieri Spagnoli
parthenope-market-santissima-settembre-2.blurb: Stalls of vintage clothes, vinyl, handmade jewellery and small Neapolitan makers, inside the former Trinità delle Monache convent complex, with music all day. Come in the morning: entry is free until 2pm and the best pieces are still there.
parthenope-market-santissima-settembre-2.place: La Santissima Community Hub, vico Trinità delle Monache

domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.title: Domenica al Museo, free entry to Naples' state museums
domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.blurb: On the first Sunday of the month, entry is free at the Archaeological Museum (MANN), Capodimonte, Palazzo Reale and the museums up in Vomero, no ticket to pay. Arrive at opening time or after 3pm, and if you can, pair San Martino with Castel Sant'Elmo, which are just a few steps apart.
domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.place: MANN, Capodimonte, Palazzo Reale, Certosa di San Martino, Castel Sant'Elmo, Villa Floridiana, Museo Pignatelli, Girolamini

domenica-al-museo-pompei-ercolano-2026-1.title: Domenica al Museo at the Pompeii and Herculaneum excavations, free entry
domenica-al-museo-pompei-ercolano-2026-1.blurb: Pompeii and Herculaneum open for free on the first Sunday of the month, and at Herculaneum that also covers Villa Sora in Torre del Greco. It's the busiest day of the month: set off early on the Circumvesuviana train and start with Herculaneum, which is easy to see in half a day.
domenica-al-museo-pompei-ercolano-2026-1.time: from 9am, closing follows the park's seasonal hours
domenica-al-museo-pompei-ercolano-2026-1.place: Parco Archeologico di Pompei and Parco Archeologico di Ercolano

mercato-antiquariato-ippodromo-agnano-20.title: Antiques market at the Agnano racecourse, every Sunday morning
mercato-antiquariato-ippodromo-agnano-20.blurb: More than two hundred stalls across the racecourse grounds: period furniture, records, postcards, silverware, second-hand clothes and plenty to rummage through. Parking is free and the good pieces are gone by 9am, so go early and bring cash.
mercato-antiquariato-ippodromo-agnano-20.place: Ippodromo di Agnano (Agnano racecourse), via Raffaele Ruggiero

campagna-amica-piazza-mercadante-sabato-.title: Campagna Amica farmers' market in piazza Mercadante, Saturdays on corso Vittorio Emanuele
campagna-amica-piazza-mercadante-sabato-.blurb: Every Saturday, Coldiretti farmers set up their stalls in piazza Mercadante: seasonal fruit and veg, buffalo mozzarella, cured meats, honey, wine and wood-fired bread. Bring a big bag, and once autumn arrives try the chestnuts and friarielli, the slightly bitter local greens.
campagna-amica-piazza-mercadante-sabato-.place: Piazza Saverio Mercadante, corso Vittorio Emanuele

campagna-amica-posillipo-sabato-2026-09-.title: Campagna Amica farmers' market in Posillipo, Saturdays in piazza Salvatore Di Giacomo
campagna-amica-posillipo-sabato-2026-09-.blurb: On Saturday mornings the little square in Posillipo fills with stalls run by Campania farmers, selling vegetables, cheese, olive oil and baked sweets. After your shopping, walk down towards Marechiaro for a coffee with a sea view.
